description: Remove emoji from a block of text, leaving the words and normal punctuation intact. Joined emoji sequences (such as a family or a flag) count as a single emoji. The copyright, registered and trademark symbols are kept. Returns the cleaned text and how many emoji were removed. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/emoji-remover/
